scope: Original foreground combat platform shared by the optional fictional expeditions; project facts, creatures, labels and controls are rendered by code.

assets.conversion: Lossless WebP; source and encoded alpha and all visible RGBA pixels were checked equal.
assets.prompt: Generate one original production game asset, a wide 2D pixel-art foreground battlefield overlay for a small indie action RPG. Transparent PNG background. Canvas composition 3:2 landscape. LOWER 45 PERCENT: an expansive ancient stone combat floor seen in a gentle side-on three-quarter perspective, broad continuous walkable central platform from left to right, clear flat footing band at 67-77% height, dark blue slate stones with irregular pixel clusters, muted teal moss and a few restrained warm amber cracks, slight battle scuffs, sparse broken geometric ruins at the far edges. UPPER 55 PERCENT: genuinely fully transparent, absolutely no sky, trees, castle, moon, horizon, or background. This art will overlay different existing environment paintings; it must read as a grounded combat plane without masking the changing environment above. Silhouette: no character, enemy, weapon, text, logos, UI frame or copied franchise symbols. Fine but unmistakably hard-edged pixel-art clusters, deliberately limited 24-color palette, crisp 1:1 pixel rhythm, no painterly brush strokes, no photographic texture, no gradients or anti-aliased glow. Independent original visual direction, not resembling any identifiable commercial game's map or iconography. Preserve alpha channel so invisible regions are actually transparent.
